```python
import requests

api_key = "sample_key4"
ip_address = "255.255.255.0"
url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}"

headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```
